prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 电商订单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "订单号" · longest unbreakable word 161px · one-line width 161px
  col 2: header "下单时间" · longest unbreakable word 41px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "商品" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 406px
  col 4: header "金额" · longest unbreakable word 69px · one-line width 69px
  col 5: header "收货地址" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 398px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示电商订单，供读者核对订单、商品、金额和收货信息。","reading":"读者先用订单号或下单时间定位一行，再横向核对商品、金额和收货地址；每行应保持清晰的整体性。较长商品名称或地址形成的行高可容纳同一行中其他内容的换行。","groups":["订单号与下单时间共同用于定位和识别订单。","商品与金额共同描述购买内容及其费用。","收货地址是履约信息，适合与同一行的订单内容一起核对。"],"keep_intact":["订单号应完整显示，避免拆分数字。","金额应完整显示，便于比较。","日期和时间各自应保持完整；空间不足时可在两者之间换行。","商品型号等连续标识应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["商品名称及规格可在自然词界换行。","收货地址可按地址层级或自然词界换行。","下单时间可在日期与时间之间换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [182, 108, 175, 90, 164] · table 720×239px · row heights [36, 83, 36, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [182, 108, 160, 90, 179] · table 720×262px · row heights [36, 83, 36, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [182, 80, 185, 90, 182] · table 720×286px · row heights [60, 83, 60, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"订单号、时间和金额均保持完整，表头清晰；长商品和地址各占三行，两条复杂订单的行高一致，便于横向核对。","problems":"长商品名称与地址都较紧凑，部分词组跨行；地址栏的折行尤其密集。","cause":"商品列175px、地址列164px，扣除内边距和边框后分别只有154px和143px可用。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"订单号、时间和金额完整，较宽的地址列让地址层级比r2A更易读。","problems":"最后一条商品名称增至四行，末尾单独留下“板）”，使该行明显偏高，商品与地址的纵向分布失衡。","cause":"商品列缩至160px，文本宽度仅139px；增加的地址宽度未能抵消商品多占一行的高度。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"商品和地址获得较多空间，长内容均控制在三行内，订单号和金额完整。","problems":"下单时间表头拆成两行，每个时间也拆成两行；短订单因此变高，时间列显得拥挤，削弱了扫描节奏。","cause":"时间列仅80px，文本宽度59px，不足以容纳完整表头或单行日期时间。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-refine","widths":[182,108,170,90,169],"change":"以r2A为基础，将5px从商品移给地址，试探能否保持商品三行，同时改善地址折行。"},{"name":"product-priority","widths":[182,108,180,90,159],"change":"从地址移出5px给商品，测试较长商品名称能否在三行内形成更自然的词组，同时观察地址是否仍可读。"},{"name":"compact-time","widths":[182,95,182,90,170],"change":"时间列保留足够宽度显示表头，允许日期与时间分行；释放的空间分给商品和地址，探索更宽的内容列是否能改善长行折行。"}]}
